verdict.rationale: Kit's documented analytics stop at engagement: broadcast stats cover recipients, opens, clicks and unsubscribes, link stats cover unique clicks per URL, and account stats cover sent, opened and clicked counts plus growth over time. Nothing in the pack ties signups or revenue to a specific email or automation flow. Selling digital products and importing purchase data are related features but are not attribution, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can attribute signups or revenue to specific emails and flows, not just opens and clicks
